transcription: Manually transcribed factual values from Table 1, printed page 3; visually checked against the PDF page. Preserve both raw and corrected concentrations and their published rounding; each branch differs from raw minus baseline by up to 0.1 ppm.

baseline.choice: Authors use the lowest measured concentration. The new uncertainty propagation is conditional on that choice and cannot bound background-selection bias.

regression.locator: Eq.11 and preceding paragraph, printed page 5
regression.reconstruction: Equal-weight least squares of the rounded table; do not replace published rounded coefficients or claim to reproduce unavailable raw regression inputs.

concentration_basis.locator: Eq.1, printed pages 2-3; Eqs.9-11, printed page 5
concentration_basis.meaning: Equivalent H2O mass / glass mass. The H2 fugacity term represents hydroxyl production, not detected molecular H2 dissolution. No conversion through the later pooled OH column is used.

experiment.host: KLB-1-derived five-major-oxide peridotite glasses; mean excludes the two most reduced glasses with Fe evaporation
experiment.gas: Flowing Ar-CO2-H2/O2 mixtures, calculated ideal fugacities; carbon-bearing experimental gas is not the M2 closed carbon-free inventory.
experiment.temperature_composition_pressure_transfe: Not independently calibrated by this fixed nominal-temperature, fixed-pressure experiment.

uncertainty.raw_concentration_sd: Published 1-sigma marginals include spectroscopy calibration uncertainty; joint covariance unavailable.
uncertainty.shared_baseline: For corrected observations y_i-y_b, even independent raw errors yield off-diagonal sigma_b^2. The subtraction must precede propagation to coefficients/predictions.
uncertainty.arbitrary_covariance_sd_bound: For any PSD covariance with the published marginal SDs, sd(L y) <= sum_i abs(L_i) sigma_i. Fixed-design, linear concentration uncertainty only; not a total prediction-error bound or confidence interval.
